newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece cuts 3-,6-,12-month T-bill rates by 50 bps.
newsitem.headline: Greece cuts 3-,6-,12-month T-bill rates by 50 bps.

text.p: Greece will issue 12-month T-bills on December 2, featuring a 50 basis point rate cut to 11.50 percent, the finance ministry said in a statement.
The renewal of three-, six- and 12-month T-bills will be at reduced rates of 10.5 percent, 10.8 percent and 11.5 percent, respectively, from November 26, it said.
The finance ministry had set three- and six-month T-bill rates at 11 percent and 11.30 percent, respectively, around mid-November.
Outstanding FRNs will be refixed at the new, lower interest rates effective November 26, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
